title_source: Michael Polansky is training an AI model on skin that’s still alive
summary_source: Michael Polansky — better known publicly as Lady Gaga's partner and a former top deputy to Sean Parker — has quietly spent years building an AI-driven startup that keeps living human skin tissue alive for weeks outside the body to discover new skincare compounds, and is only now going public about it.

title_en: Samsung Electronics ranks first in TV shipments in the first half of this year... Mini LED TV breakthrough
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Samsung Electronics' TV shipments in the first half of this year amounted to 17.6 million units, a 6.3% increase compared to the same period last year. It is the largest in the industry, and the strengthening of the mini LED TV lineup is believed to have had a major impact. According to market research firm Trend Force on the 22nd, global TV shipments in the first half of this year amounted to 93.74 million units, up 1.3% from the previous quarter. Although this is the highest in the first half since COVID-19, the market is expected to shrink on an annual basis this year. This is because memory prices are skyrocketing, led by the AI ​​industry, and the profitability of mid- to low-priced TV manufacturers is greatly deteriorating. Major brands maintained their market share through cost advantages. Trend Force explained, “Worldwide TV shipments this year are expected to be 194.65 million units, down 0.8% from the previous year,” and added, “In the short term, TV manufacturers will focus on improving product value by expanding the introduction of QLED and Mini LED TVs.” QLED and Mini LED are premium products among LCD TVs. Samsung Electronics recorded a total of 17.6 million TV shipments in the first half of this year. It maintained first place in the industry with a 6.3% increase compared to the same period last year. In particular, mini LED TV shipments surged by more than 200% compared to the same period last year...

AI 산업 주도로 메모리 가격이 폭등하면서 중저가 TV 제조업체들의 수익성이 크게 악화되고 있기 때문이다. 주요 브랜드는 비용 우위를 통해 시장 점유율을 유지했다.트렌드포스는 "올해 전 세계 TV 출하량은 전년 대비 0.8% 감소한 1억9465만대로 전망된다"며 "단기적으로 TV 제조업체들은 QLED와 미니LED TV 도입을 확대하는 등 제품 가치 향상에 주력할 것"이라고 설명했다. title_ja: 宇宙人「洗濯悩み」の終わり…服洗濯する銃出てきた
summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]宇宙に滞在する宇宙飛行士の悩みの一つは洗濯物だった。宇宙では洗濯ができず、同じ服を数週間着用しなければならなかった。宇宙で着た服は密閉された封筒に入れて地球に持ってきて洗濯したり、大気圏に入った時に燃やしてしまう方式が一般的だった。短期宇宙ミッションを遂行する時は、このような方法を使っても大きな群れはなかった。しかし、数ヶ月以上かかる火星探査任務では、大きな悩みのひとつだった。宇宙飛行士たちの長年の悩みを和らげる新しい洗濯方法が開発されたと科学媒体スペースドットコムが最近報道した。少なくとも微生物学的にきれいに保ち、宇宙飛行士の健康を守ってくれるだろう。太陽から観測されるプラズマは非常に熱いが、今回開発された洗濯銃のプラズマは室温に近い冷たい状態を維持する。 バクテリアを…。
title_en: Astronaut's laundry worries come to an end... A gun for washing clothes has been released
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] One of the headaches of astronauts staying in space was laundry. You can't do laundry in space, so you have to wear the same clothes for weeks. It was common for clothes worn in space to be brought to Earth in sealed bags and either washed or burned upon entering the atmosphere. There was no problem using this method when performing short-term space missions. However, this was one of the biggest concerns during a Mars exploration mission that took several months or more. Science media outlet Space.com recently reported that a new washing method has been developed to relieve astronauts' long-standing concerns. According to the report, researchers led by Professor Gabe Xu of the University of Alabama Hunsville have developed a prototype 'plasma washing gun' that can wash clothes in outer space. Professor Gabe Xu said, "It will protect the health of astronauts by keeping clothes and other soft surfaces at least microbiologically clean," and added, "We will bring spacesuits and various tools to Mars. “It can also be useful for sterilizing things before stepping on them.” Plasma is a mixture of charged ions and electrons that move with energy. title_ja: [ビデオ] 「報告書だけにAIを書く企業、結局遅れる」…ポチトゥマルのAX生存法
summary_ja: 「ジディネットコリア」「報告書を書くとき、資料を整理するときだけ人工知能（AI）を使うわけではありません。今、AIはすべての活動で自然に活用する「伴侶技術」と考えなければなりません。」考え方から実行構造まで全般をAI中心に転換するのが真のAXという説明だ。代表はこの日インタビューで製造現場で確認したAX成果から中小・中堅企業の導入格差、公共部門の活用方向までAXの現在と課題を挙げた。レポートの作成や資料の整理、翻訳、検索支援など、一部の業務にAIを適用するレベルでは、組織の競争力を根本的に変えることが難しいということだ。
title_en: [Video] “Companies that only use AI for reports ultimately fall behind”… 42Maru’s AX Survival Method
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] "Artificial intelligence (AI) is not only used when writing reports or organizing data. Now, we must think of AI as a 'companion technology' that can be used naturally in all activities." Kim Dong-hwan, CEO of 42Maru, emphasized in a video interview on the 21st that the essence of AI transformation (AX) cannot be realized by limiting application of AI to specific tasks. He explains that true AX is about converting everything from the way of thinking to the execution structure to AI-centered. He said, “AI must be incorporated in all actions from the time you wake up in the morning until you go to sleep,” and that the corporate work environment should also change in the direction of having so-called ‘AI DNA.’ In an interview that day, CEO Kim, who leads 42Maru, which focuses on domain-specialized industry AX and public AX, discussed AX’s performance from the performance of AX confirmed at the manufacturing site to the gap in adoption by small and medium-sized companies and the direction of utilization in the public sector. He pointed out the current situation and challenges. CEO Kim pointed out that AX should not be viewed as simply a matter of adding generative AI. It is difficult to fundamentally change an organization's competitiveness by applying AI to only a few tasks, such as report writing, data organization, translation, and search assistance. AI is not a tool that is called only when necessary, but is a natural part of the entire work process...

title_ja: Google、マーベルに17兆ウォン持分オプション…カスタムAIチップ大反撃
summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア] Google（Google）がカスタマイズされたAI半導体の確保に勝負をかけた。 Yahoo Financeによると、8月20日、グーグルは半導体企業マーベル（Marvell）とカスタムチップの協力を拡大し、マーベル株式を大量に買うことができるウォーレント（株式購入権）を受けた。全量行使時の持分価値は最大122億ドル、ウォンで約17兆ウォンに達する。 ウォーレントはマーベル普通株約5,897万株を1株当たり206.58ドルに買える権利で、2033年8月まで有効である。グーグルはチップ注文が５億ドル分ずつ満たされる度に買収権の次の区間が開かれる仕組みで権利を確保する。 Googleのテンソル処理装置（TPU）エコシステムに合わせたAI推論アクセラレータとストレージコントローラ、ネットワークインタフェースコントローラ、メモリインタフェースコントローラなどのデータセンター用半導体が対象である。 GoogleはTPUを内部用資産から商業プラットフォームに拡張してきており、特定のAI作業ではNVIDIA GPUの代替として掲げている。
title_en: Google grants 17 trillion won equity option to Marvell... Customized AI chip counterattack
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Google has bet on securing customized AI semiconductors. According to Yahoo Finance, on August 20, Google expanded its customized chip cooperation with semiconductor company Marvell and received a warrant to purchase a large number of Marvell stocks. When all shares are exercised, the value of the stake reaches up to $12.2 billion, or approximately 17 trillion won in Korean won. The warrant is the right to purchase approximately 58.97 million shares of Marvell common stock at $206.58 per share, and is valid until August 2033. Google secures the rights through a structure in which the next section of the purchase right is opened whenever chip orders worth $500 million are filled. The commercial contract on which this warrant is based was signed on July 29. The target is data center semiconductors such as AI inference accelerators tailored to Google's tensor processing unit (TPU) ecosystem, storage controllers, network interface controllers, and memory interface controllers. The reason this contract is attracting attention is because it shows Google's trend of expanding its own chip ecosystem and reducing its dependence on Nvidia. summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] U.S. cybersecurity authorities issued an urgent warning about hacking threats targeting industrial control systems.
